tasks.goal: A zero-dependency Node HTTP JSON API 'pingd' (pingd.js): GET /ping returns 200 {"pong":true}; GET /version returns 200 {"version":"1.0.0"}; any other path returns 404 with a JSON error. Ship package.json and a README with a 'Verified probes' section documenting every request made with its real observed status code and body. The plan MUST include a SEPARATE FINAL VERIFICATION STEP distinct from the build: start the server fresh, re-run EVERY probe documented in the README exactly as written, and confirm observed status codes and bodies match the README claims.
